1 · Intro

When to use it.

HCMs don't run payroll. Payroll runs payroll. Your job is getting records and time cards right so payroll can run cleanly.

This course sorts out what you own and what payroll owns, by pay type.

Use this whenYou are new to the HCM role, or you are not sure whether a pay issue is yours to fix.

Watch-outs

  • Never try to run or rerun payroll yourself. That is payroll's job.

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

The HCM's role in payroll

Use when: You are new to the HCM role, or you are not sure whether a pay issue is yours to fix. · System: Overview

  1. All new hires: you own the hire.
    • Process the hire correctly.
    • Confirm every payroll element is on the record.
  2. Exempt (monthly) employees: hands off, with two exceptions.
    • Add a compensation payment when needed, such as a lump sum.
    • Work an issue with payroll when one comes up.
  3. Weekly and biweekly employees: check time cards every week.
    • Confirm every time card is submitted.
    • Chase managers for missing or late time cards.
    • Escalate errors you can't resolve to payroll.
  4. Errors: you work them with payroll.

Watch-outs

  • Never try to run or rerun payroll yourself. That is payroll's job.
  • Open item: the exact payroll elements to confirm at hire are still being documented with the payroll team.
